description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter for displaying prayer times in an Android application. It manages a list of prayer time pairs, inflates item views, and binds prayer names and times to the UI components.

classes.name: PrayerTimesAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter class for displaying a list of prayer times, with internal ViewHolder class.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Updates the adapter's data set with new prayer times and refreshes the view.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates new ViewHolder instances by inflating item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds prayer name and time to the ViewHolder views.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items to display.

inner_classes.name: VH
inner_classes.description: ViewHolder class holding references to the TextViews for prayer name and time.
